artworks.title: Ulysses and Polyphemus
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson, after Francesco Primaticcio
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in yellow and black on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 19.7 × 25.6 cm (7 3/4 × 10 1/16 in.) (trimmed on all sides)
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a scene featuring a large figure with a staff, surrounded by sheep. A ship and a group of people can be seen in the background. The large figure is reclining on the ground with a staff. In the distance, a group of people is departing on a ship. The detailed linework and shading give depth to the figure, landscape, and sheep. The illustration is done in a style reminiscent of classical and Renaissance engravings, focusing on anatomy and narrative.

artworks.title: Boats
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on Japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a collection of bold, dark geometric shapes and lines contrasted with lighter areas, creating an abstract composition. The angular and triangular forms suggest boats. The lines at the bottom resemble waves or reflections.

artworks.title: Woman Standing Holding a Jar on the Head
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from two blocks in yellow and black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed engraving of a person from the waist up. The figure is in a dynamic pose, with an arm raised above their head, holding a large, round vessel or urn. The person is in profile, facing to the right, with classical facial features, including a defined nose and slightly parted lips. The hair is styled in loose, wavy curls that frame the face and extend down the neck. The individual appears to be wearing a garment that drapes elegantly over one shoulder and wraps around the body, with intricate folds and pleats. The background consists of fine, parallel lines providing a textured effect. The bottom of the image contains an inscription in a decorative script.

artworks.title: Adolph Menzel Wearing a Top Hat
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on chine collé
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of Christopher and Beverly With in
memory of Karl and Gerda With
artworks.description: The image features a man shown from the shoulders up, facing partly left with a stern expression. He has deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, a strong jawline, and thick mutton chops as well as a mustache framing his face. The man wears a tall black top hat, a dark formal coat with wide lapels, and is set against a dark, cross-hatched background. The portrait is detailed and rendered in a monochrome palette.

artworks.title: The Visitation
artworks.medium: black chalk, heightened with white, on prepared paper washed purple
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of four full-bodied figures. The central figure is embracing another figure, both figures are wearing long flowing garments with head coverings. The figures have indistinct facial features due to the sketch's style but appear to convey interaction through their gestures. To the left, there is an older man with curly hair and a beard, draped in loose robes, holding a staff. On the right, another woman stands with her hands clasped, her hair loosely tied back, wearing a similarly styled robe. The background suggests a cityscape or architectural elements faintly sketched. The artwork has a monochromatic, subdued color palette, primarily using shades of brown with white highlights.

artworks.title: The Haunting (Hantise)
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper, marked for reduction of image
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a woman being approached by a winged figure. The image is composed of intricate pencil lines, creating a textured and detailed scene. To the left, a woman is walking forward with a serene expression, wearing a flowing dress. Her hair is pulled back, and the dress appears to be pulled slightly by her motion. Behind and slightly to the right of her, a figure with wings is depicted, in a gesture as if reaching out to touch the flowing fabric of her dress. The background consists of crosshatching that adds a sense of depth and atmosphere. The drawing has meticulous linework showcasing skillful shading and texture.

artworks.title: The Good Samaritan
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a dense forest scene from a slightly elevated angle, showcasing intricate details. The horizon is not immediately clear due to tall trees taking up much of the upper portion. In the center, there are two figures and a camel partially obscured by foliage. The etching technique reveals fine brushwork capturing textures of leaves, tree bark, and landscape patterns. The grayscale color palette ranges from deep blacks to various shades of gray and white with high contrast. The undergrowth is intricately detailed with thickets and ferns, while in the distance, trees thin out, allowing some light through. The sky above is filled with layered clouds, offering a dramatic backdrop.

artworks.title: A Winter Landscape Within a Jugendstil Border
artworks.medium: pen and black ink, with corrective marks in white, on two joined sheets of card
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees standing on a snow-covered terrain. In the background, there is a line of trees against the sky with birds flying. The foreground features tree trunks and bushes with fine, detailed lines and cross-hatching for texture. The color palette is black and white, emphasizing contrast. Decorative patterns frame the image.

artworks.title: Sunlit Trees in a Valley near Lacoux
artworks.medium: graphite heightened with white chalk on blue wove paper, with vertical strips of slightly different blue paper added at left and right edges
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helen Porter and James T. Dyke
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rolling hills, foliage, trees, and a pathway or stream. Hills in the distance suggest depth and recession. The brushwork is subtle and minimalist, capturing textures of leaves and terrain. The color palette is muted, dominated by shades of gray and hints of blue. The sky above is softly rendered, creating a sense of openness and calmness.

artworks.title: A Stand of Birch Trees
artworks.medium: brown and gray wash with pen and brown ink over black chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a dense forest scene with tall trees and intertwining branches in a naturalistic style. The perspective is from a slightly low angle, emphasizing the branches reaching into the sky. The focus is on the trees, filling the vertical composition. The brushstrokes are detailed, depicting the texture of the bark and leaves. The color palette includes earth tones and a pale blue-gray tint in the background, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: A Fortress in a Mountain Landscape at Sunrise
artworks.medium: gouache with pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rolling hills in the distance. In the foreground, there is a shepherd playing a flute under a tree, surrounded by sheep. Another tree is on the left, and there is a cluster of buildings, including a church, between the trees. The colors are predominantly blues, greens, and earth tones, creating a serene atmosphere. The sky is light blue with some clouds.

artworks.title: Agnes von Felsen
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows the head and shoulders of a woman in a three-quarter view looking slightly to her left. Her facial features include large eyes, a straight nose, and full lips. Her hair is dark with a braid across the top, and she is wearing a bonnet or headscarf tied under her chin. She is not wearing visible jewelry or holding any objects. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Giudecca Canal with Shipping near the Chiesa dei Gesuati
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a waterfront scene from above, featuring docked boats near grand buildings. In the background, the sky meets the water, with sailboats and a large ship visible. The buildings on the right have detailed facades and arched windows, extending into the distance. A gentle, warm light illuminates the structures. The brushwork appears delicate and light, possibly employing a watercolor technique. The color palette includes serene blues and greys of the sky and water, contrasting with earthy tones of the buildings and boats. Close to us, a few small boats float on the water, with its ripples reflecting the surroundings.

artworks.title: Hampstead Heath, Evening Light
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray and blue-gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a town or village surrounded by trees and hills. The composition is elevated, capturing a broad perspective with the horizon high in the frame. The painting features subtle brushstrokes to create smooth transitions and soft silhouettes. Earthy tones dominate the foreground, while light brown and beige hues define the distant area. The color palette and strokes create a tranquil atmosphere. Two figures are depicted sitting and looking towards the view.

artworks.title: La Compagnia dei sacconi al Colosseo (Penitents Praying at Altars in the Colosseum)
artworks.medium: watercolor over black chalk and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious procession inside an ancient amphitheater. The scene depicts an interior view of the Colosseum, portrayed in sepia tones. The painting portrays a religious procession of hooded figures wearing long robes, with some carrying small pictures or emblems. The central focus is on these figures arranged in a line within the Colosseum's ruins. On the right, beneath the archway, is a shrine with a depiction of the crucifixion, around which a woman is shown kneeling in prayer while holding a child. The scene conveys a sense of solemnity, with the ruined architecture looming over the gathered figures. The style is reminiscent of an 18th to 19th-century European artist.

artworks.title: A Crouching Apostle (Saint Peter)
artworks.artist: Adam von Bartsch, after a drawing formerly attributed to Albrecht Dürer
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jane Tarleton Smith Moore
artworks.description: The image depicts a person kneeling with their torso slightly bent backwards, looking up. The person has detailed facial features, shoulder-length hair, and is dressed in flowing robes. The background is plain in sepia tone with multiple borders framing the figure.

artworks.title: God the Father with Angels
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jane Tarleton Smith Moore
artworks.description: The drawing features loosely sketched figures on a cloud-like form with flowing, fabric-like lines around them. The figures exhibit movement, with outlines made using quick, fluid strokes. The central figure is larger and flanked by smaller figures. The shading is monochrome, enhancing the dynamic quality of the composition. The emphasis appears to be on expressiveness over realism.

artworks.title: Young Woman in a Kerchief and Cloak at Hastings
artworks.medium: watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in profile, facing right. She is hunched forward with her hands clasped under her cloak. Her facial expression is contemplative. Her hair is light brown and wavy, partially covered by a blue hood or scarf. She wears a large brown cloak, a long checkered dress, a blue headscarf, and dark shoes. The background is plain with a light, textured surface, indicating an indoor setting.

artworks.title: La Rieuse: Madame Albert Besnard
artworks.medium: color lithograph, printed in two shades of brown and gold on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in a three-quarter profile, looking over her shoulder towards the viewer. Her hair is dark and wavy, blending into the background. She wears a large hat with an orange floral embellishment and a dark wrap around her shoulders. Her face is softly rendered with delicate features and a gentle smile, partially obscured by her hand near her chin. The background is a textured surface in muted tones.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with Saint John the Baptist
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays three figures in a domestic setting. On the left, an adult female sits wearing a long garment. Beside her, a young child stands with a hand on her lap, while another child kneels to the right. Behind the kneeling child, an adult figure wearing robes and holding a staff is seated. A window behind them shows a landscape with trees and hills under a cloudy sky. Drapes frame the indoor scene.

artworks.title: La Fete Nationale au Boulevard de Clichy (National Holiday on the Boulevard de Clichy)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint, and saltground on blue paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift from the Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a busy street setting with a central lamppost. The scene includes various buildings decorated with flags, a sidewalk filled with people, including children and a dog, and street vendors with carts. The border is filled with detailed drawings of carriages, figures, activities, and mythical creatures, creating a dynamic atmosphere.

artworks.title: Louis Galloche
artworks.artist: Johann Gotthard Müller, after Louis Tocqué
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated from the waist up facing the viewer with his right arm resting on a ledge in an oval frame in the engraving. He has a round face, a prominent nose, and a composed expression, with curly white or grey hair. He wears a dark robe with loose sleeves and a scarf around his neck. On the ledge are rolled scrolls and an artist's palette with brushes. The background features textured patterns within the oval frame and decorative borders, including a green and gold border.

artworks.title: Baalbeck
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient stone structure with towering columns. Some columns are intact while others are broken. Stones are scattered on the ground, indicating a historical ruin. The color palette is warm sepia tone, giving the scene an antique look. The sky is clear and the focus is on the stone structure.

artworks.title: The Virtues Crushing the Vices, Strasbourg Cathedral
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.creditLine: Robert and Paula Hershkowitz in memory of Sam Wagstaff
artworks.description: The image shows four sculpted figures standing in a row within niches decorated with pointed arches and intricate carvings characteristic of Gothic architecture. The figures are crafted from light-colored stone, potentially limestone or marble, with weathering visible. Each figure wears long robes and holds an object or gesture, with some details worn or broken. The serene faces display finely carved details. Above the figures are ornate architectural elements, enhancing the sculpture.
